p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1], col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1])
              for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda b: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(b[0], b[1]) for c in range(b[2], b[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,d,e in panels:
        for r in range(a,b):
            for c in range(d,e):
                out[r][c] = grid[r0 + (r-a) % (r1-r0)][c0 + (c-d) % (c1-c0)]
    return out
''')
